description_en: Queries the logs of an IPsec server by calling the ListIpsecServerLogs operation
description_zh: 调用ListIpsecServerLogs接口查看IPsec服务端日志
kebab_example: aliyun vpc list-ipsec-server-logs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ipsec-server-id iss-2zei2n5q5zhirfh730000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListIpsecServerLogs

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the IPsec server.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
IPsec服务端所属地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IPsec server
parameters.name: ipsec_server_id

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the log. Only UNIX timestamps in seconds are supported. For example, 1671003744 represents 2022-12-14 15:42:24.

If you specify From, you must also specify To or MinutePeriod
parameters.help_zh:
日志起始时间，仅支持传入UNIX秒级时间戳，例如1671003744，1671003744表示的时间为2022年12月14日15:42:24。

如果指定From，则必须指定To或MinutePeriod
parameters.name: from

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the log. Only UNIX timestamps in seconds are supported. For example, 1671004344 represents 2022-12-14 15:52:24.

If you specify To, you must also specify From or MinutePeriod
parameters.help_zh:
日志结束时间，仅支持传入UNIX秒级时间戳，例如1671004344，1671004344表示的时间为2022年12月14日15:52:24。

如果指定To，则必须指定From或MinutePeriod
parameters.name: to

parameters.help_en:
The log period. Valid values: 1 to 10. Unit: minutes.

If you do not specify From or To, you must specify MinutePeriod
parameters.help_zh:
日志周期。取值范围：1~10。单位：分钟。

如果不指定From和To，则必须指定MinutePeriod
parameters.name: minute_period

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paging. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页显示的条目数。取值范围：1~50。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

Count.description_en: The number of log entries on the current page
Count.description_zh: 当前页下日志的条目数

items.description_en:
A string array.

Each item in the array is a log entry
items.description_zh:
字符串数组。

数组中的每一项都为一条日志
items.example: "2022-12-15 17:00:43 [INFO]: : iss-2zei2n5q5zhirfh73**** del ipsec policy successfully", "2022-12-15 17:00:43 [INFO]: : iss-2zei2n5q5zhirfh73**** add ipsec policy successfully"

IsCompleted.description_en:
Indicates whether the queried logs are accurate. Valid values:

true: Accurate.
false: Not accurate
IsCompleted.description_zh:
查询的日志是否精确。取值：

true：精确。
false：不精确

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page for paging
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页显示的条目数
